The bias-corrected monitor is therefore exactly \(q\), so the source trigger fires at its first eligible step. value.rationale: The automatic switchover and automatically learned SGD rate are the central design features of SWATS. The result identifies a structural gap between 'the estimated rate stopped changing' and 'the estimated rate is safe': even exact stationarity can select any prescribed unstable scalar rate. Because the family uses positive tolerance and interior beta2, the obstruction is not a normalization artifact, and it directly motivates adding a magnitude- or curvature-sensitive safety check.
